correctness.rationale: W1 common-uniform contraction supplies unique invariant measure; stationarity gives exact mean and variance identity; closed positive two-state class is exact; negative fractional phase converges using a uniform bound on (1-r)^2 second moment; martingale-difference coupling to iid Bernoulli noises yields vanishing normalized L2 error and Lindeberg Gaussian limit. Exact rational Markov checks and independent fixed-seed simulations passed, while infinite proof is analytic.

originality.rationale: Distinct sharp sign-reversal stationary law and nondegenerate near-minus-one Gaussian limit for fixed-grid unbiased rounding. The same quantizer, conditional variance, and general AR moments are acknowledged as prior. Open-access primary article comparisons did not show the combined limit or imply it as a stated specialization; specialist precedence risk remains.

Fixed lattice spacing differs from practical floating-point grids, so transferring this limit requires further analysis.

value.rationale: A natural sign change of one scalar contraction factor, with identical unrounded fixed point and magnitude, changes invariant error from bounded Bernoulli to diverging Gaussian-scaled fluctuations. The exact constant and weak limit quantify a severe roundoff stability blind spot not visible to mean or deterministic contraction rates, useful as a benchmark for low-precision fixed-point and overrelaxed iterative solvers.
